name: fair-rank
title: Fair Rank
description: Ranks ties the standard competition way (1, T-2, T-2, 4) at the precision shown so equal-looking scores share a rank, shows movement since last period, and sets aside entries below a minimum sample with the reason and the rank they would have had.

meta.stops: Tied players shown with different ranks
meta.summary: Ranks ties fairly at the precision shown and sets aside entries with too few samples, so leaderboards don't mislead.
catches: Entries with too few samples, set aside with the reason
limits: Ties are judged at the displayed precision; finer differences are ignored on purpose
a11y: A real table with a header row
Ties and movement are stated in text ("tied", up/down labels), not only colour or arrows
Row animations are skipped with prefers-reduced-motion
